test.name: Hints found: the review decides each one, logs each accept and reject against the hints item, and completes it
test.description: The router hands search-hints the planned hints item pli_007 for Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF). Three hints are pending. The review decides each hint itself, logs each new accept and reject naming pli_007, and sets pli_007 completed. It does not wait for the researcher: the research decides hints, and the researcher may overrule it later.

input.delegation:
Review the pending FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn for plan item pli_007.

personId: LZNY-BRF
planItemId: pli_007
planId: pl_002
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The three pending hints are the 1870 census (M70C, confidence 5), the 1880 census (M80C, confidence 4) and the 1908 death certificate (MDEF, confidence 4). The death certificate is already linked: extracted as src_004 and linked to Patrick by pe_005
The 1880 census index has the surname as 'Glynn'; its image reads 'Flynn, Patrick', so that hint is not rejected

Each new accept and reject is logged as a person_record_matches entry naming pli_007; the death certificate, already linked, is not logged. pli_007 is then set completed through research_append on plan_items
The return does not ask the researcher to decide; the researcher-facing text says what was decided and what happens next
